stem: A courier company in Dhaka models the value of one of its delivery vans, in thousands of taka, \(t\) years after it was bought by the function \(f(t) = 1{,}500(0.8)^{t}\). According to the model, what is the value of the van, in thousands of taka, 2 years after it was bought?
verify:
t = symbols('t')
f = 1500 * Rational(8, 10)**t
assert f.subs(t, 2) == 960
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [960]
